name: Setup
description: Configure Evyasys for this project — choose PM tool (Local / Azure DevOps / JIRA / GitHub Projects) and notification channel (None / Teams / Slack / WhatsApp / Email), then collect and encrypt credentials. Safe to re-run to update config or rotate secrets.

name: TrainDocs
description: Scan the entire codebase and generate 37 quality-gate documents into .evyasys/docs/ covering architecture, standards, patterns, testing, security, design system, UI/UX standards, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), visual quality, styling tokens, hook rules, dependency governance, and more. Pass --retrain to regenerate only docs affected by recent git changes.

name: CreateFunctionalDocs
description: Generate plain-language, RAG-ready functional documentation per business module into .evyasys/docs/functional/ — covering entities, access & permissions, validations, actions, business logic, workflows, error scenarios, integration points. Use --all, a module name, or --update <ModuleName>.

name: CreateStory
description: Draft a complete business story from project context — asks clarifying questions one at a time, handles Epic filing, pushes to Azure DevOps and notifies Teams on approval.

name: CreateSubtask
description: Decompose a story into developer-ready tasks — presents 2-3 breakdown strategies for team approval, then writes 3-8 tasks each ≤ 1 day. Pass StoryID e.g. EVYA-1042.

name: StartDev
description: Kick off development — architecture reference scan, structured technical brainstorm (3+ approaches, team approval), then branch/PR/DoR/dependency gates. Transitions ADO to In Progress. Pass one or more story IDs, an Epic ID, or a mix.

name: ReviewDev
description: Independent code review — AC coverage, correctness, architecture consistency, UI consistency, security, YAGNI, test quality. Evidence-based findings with file+line citations. Critical issues block FinishDev. Pass StoryID.

name: FinishDev
description: Wrap development — AC audit, DoD checklist, diff scope check, Dev Summary. Transitions ADO to Ready for QA. Pass StoryID.

name: StartQa
description: Generate a comprehensive test plan — confirms environment and data first, then writes AC-driven positive/negative/edge/regression/non-functional cases. Transitions ADO to In QA. Pass StoryID.

name: FinishQa
description: Release sign-off — validates all TC outcomes recorded, no P0/P1 defects open, all domain gates green (Security/Performance/Accessibility+VisualQuality/DataIntegrity). Drafts plain-language release notes. Transitions ADO to Done. Pass StoryID.

name: GenerateReleaseNote
description: Compile a short, beautiful, branded PDF release notes document from one or more completed stories. Pass story IDs as arguments, or omit to be asked. Groups by Epic, emoji quality gate table, compact format. e.g. EVYA-1042 EVYA-1043.

name: Update
description: Update the Evyasys plugin to the latest version — check installed vs. latest, show changelog highlights, manage compression preference, then run 3 reinstall commands. Project config and credentials are not affected.

name: Repair
description: Clean reinstall for broken plugin state — clears plugin cache and settings entries, then shows the 4-step reinstall sequence. Project config, credentials, docs, board artefacts, and compression preferences are never touched.
